command:
set -eu
payload=/home/root/pi-ink-bridge-0020
backup=/home/root/pi-ink-webserver-remote-backup-0020
original=/home/root/xovi/extensions.d/webserver-remote.so
adapter=/home/root/xovi/extensions.d/pi-ink-loopback-0020.so
patch=/home/root/xovi/exthome/qt-resource-rebuilder/pi-ink-bridge-0020.qmd
(cd "$payload" && sha256sum -c payload-sha256.txt)
chmod 700 "$payload/pi-ink-tablet"
chmod 600 "$payload/config.json" "$payload/trust/server-a.pem" "$payload/trust/server-b.pem"
test -f "$original"; test ! -L "$original"
printf '%s  %s\n' 24bcfe6c0b0b44c35401f214b0ccc451cdb60d2fd0e8c718beac92be25f6dd0f "$original" | sha256sum -c -
test "$(stat -c '%a %u %g %s %Y' "$original")" = '644 0 0 8453696 1793049401'
stat -c '%a %u %g %s %Y %n' "$original"
test ! -e "$backup/webserver-remote.so"; test ! -L "$backup/webserver-remote.so"
test ! -e "$adapter"; test ! -L "$adapter"; test ! -e "$patch"; test ! -L "$patch"
mv "$original" "$backup/webserver-remote.so"
(set -C; cat "$payload/adapter.so" > "$adapter")
(set -C; cat "$payload/pi-ink-bridge.qmd" > "$patch")
chmod 644 "$adapter" "$patch"
systemctl restart xochitl
sleep 8
systemctl is-active xochitl
printf 'OWNED_HASHES\n'
sha256sum "$adapter" "$patch" "$backup/webserver-remote.so"
stat -c '%a %u %g %s %Y %n' "$backup/webserver-remote.so"
printf 'LISTENERS\n'
cat /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6
